name: Athora Bruges Marathon
summary: The Athora Bruges Marathon is held in early October. It starts at 't Zand and finishes on the Grote Markt in the centre of Bruges. The organisers describe a flat, fast course through Bruges and the surrounding polders.
courseHighlights: Medieval towers and canals of Bruges

paceStrategy.summary: Organisers describe the course as flat, so an even pace is realistic. The roads in the old town can be crowded at the start, so keep the first kilometres calm.

segments.advice: Start calm and avoid weaving in the crowded streets.

segments.terrain: Flat polder roads outside the city
segments.advice: Hold an even pace; countryside can be exposed to wind.

segments.terrain: Return to Bruges and the Grote Markt
segments.advice: Hold your pace and use the crowds in the centre.

fuelingNotes: The organisers list refreshment stations on the course, with Etixx isotonic drink and isotonic energy gel at the aid stations. A fuelling plan is published on the official site.
tips: Bib pick-up is at Sint-Lodewijckscollege, on the day before the race and on race morning
The start is about 1.5 km from Bruges station
Practise with the Etixx drink and gel in training if you plan to use the aid stations
The finish line closes on the Grote Markt in the afternoon; check the practical info page

faq.question: Is the Bruges Marathon flat?
faq.answer: Yes. The organisers describe both the marathon and half marathon courses as flat and fast.

faq.question: When is the Bruges Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is held on a Sunday in early October.

faq.question: Where does the Bruges Marathon start and finish?
faq.answer: It starts at 't Zand and finishes on the Grote Markt in Bruges.
